red.definition: of the colour of fresh blood:

green.definition: of a colour between blue and yellow; of the colour of grass:

yellow.definition: a colour like that of a lemon or gold or the sun:

blue.definition: of the colour of the sky without clouds on a bright day, or a darker or lighter type of this:

black.definition: having the darkest colour there is, like the colour of coal or of a very dark night:

white.definition: of a colour like that of snow, milk, or bone:

cat.definition: a small animal with fur, four legs, a tail, and claws, usually kept as a pet or for catching mice :

dog.definition: a common animal with four legs, especially kept by people as a pet or to hunt or guard things:

pig.definition: a large pink, brown, or black farm animal with short legs and a curved tail, kept for its meat:

duck.definition: a bird that lives by water and has webbed feet (= feet with skin between the toes), a short neck, and a large beak:

fish.definition: an animal that lives in water, is covered with scales, and breathes by taking water in through its mouth, or the flesh of these animals eaten as food:

bird.definition: a creature with feathers and wings, usually able to fly:

panda.definition: a large, black and white mammal that lives in forests in China. Pandas eat bamboo.

monkey.definition: an animal that lives in hot countries, has a long tail, and climbs trees. Monkeys are primates (= the group of animals that are most like humans) .

tiger.definition: a large wild animal of the cat family with yellowish-orange fur with black lines that lives in parts of Asia

elephant.definition: a very large grey mammal that has a trunk (= long nose) with which it can pick things up

rabbit.definition: a small animal with long ears and large front teeth that moves by jumping on its long back legs, or the meat of this animal eaten as food:

bear.definition: to accept, tolerate, or endure something, especially something unpleasant:

apple.definition: a round fruit with firm, white flesh and a green, red, or yellow skin:

banana.definition: a long, curved fruit with a yellow skin and soft, sweet, white flesh inside:

orange.definition: a round sweet fruit that has a thick orange skin and an orange centre divided into many parts, or the tree that this fruit comes from:

pear.definition: a sweet fruit, usually with a green skin and a lot of juice, that has a round base and is slightly pointed towards the stem

grape.definition: a small, round, purple or pale green fruit that you can eat or make into wine:

watermelon.definition: a large, round or oval-shaped fruit with dark green skin, sweet pink flesh, and a lot of black seeds

strawberry.definition: a small juicy red fruit that has small brown seeds on its surface, or the plant with white flowers on which this fruit grows:

eye.definition: one of the two organs in your face that are used for seeing:

ear.definition: either of the two organs, one on each side of the head, by which people or animals hear sounds, or the piece of skin and tissue outside the head connected to th

nose.definition: the part of the face that sticks out above the mouth, through which you breathe and smell:

mouth.definition: the opening in the face of a person or animal, consisting of the lips and the space between them, or the space behind containing the teeth and the tongue:

hand.definition: the part of the body at the end of the arm that is used for holding, moving, touching, and feeling things:

foot.definition: the part of the body at the bottom of the leg on which a person or animal stands:

baby.definition: a very young child, especially one that has not yet begun to walk or talk:

sun.definition: the star that provides light and heat for the earth and around which the earth moves:

bus.definition: a large vehicle in which people are driven from one place to another:

fox.definition: a wild mammal belonging to the dog family that has a pointed face and ears, a wide tail covered in fur, and often reddish-brown fur

bed.definition: a large, rectangular piece of furniture, often with four legs, used for sleeping on:

hat.definition: a covering for the head that is not part of a piece of clothing:
